scope: At a 60-hour reporting cutoff within a 65-hour simulation, test whether a ready aircraft is visibly preassigned to a pending two-aircraft mission while the second aircraft remains in an already accepted active SURP removal. Mission preassignment is distinct from stocked-item reservation and is not a 65-hour simulation-terminal state.
pre_run_hypotheses: The authored delta from accepted active-removal input is Control.SIMPE 60→65 plus one appended row each in MissionType, OperationProfile, MissionPreparation and MissionTurnround. Control.RCEND and both ResultCollection.RCEND rows stay 60. All other existing rows, repair duration, stock, resources and seed are identical.

BASIC-SCHEDULE is the root profile. Its new one-off TERMINAL-HOLD child at relative hour 60.5 should be ordered around hour 59.5, with a short nominal mission and allowed delay contained inside the 65-hour simulation. Native Operations #204 acceptance remains conditional; any converter semantic diagnostic excludes this candidate and its raw bytes remain sealed.

A ready aircraft should be preassigned to TERMINAL-HOLD at the 60-hour report cutoff while the second is still in active SURP. Require direct mission preassign event and no release/cancellation by hour 60, plus the final 59.5–60 System interval; do not identify SystemResults.NSYMR as an inventory reservation or infer stock reservation from a received LRU. ResultSummary covers the longer simulation and is not a 60-hour terminal summary.

Guarded session-0 SSH import, export, calculation, JSON report and exact populated-table roundtrip must complete under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue with GUI PID 13340 preserved. Require zero converter errors, only reviewed Warning #108, valid SXO, log and report. New diagnostic or malformed output excludes acceptance.

Preserve the original fault and arrival path if it occurs; a changed random prefix requires re-analysis and revised claims. Read the full event log beyond 60 only to verify that the simulation executed cleanly.

Accept only a directly observed hour-60 reporting-cutoff mission preassignment and other directly observed states after author and separate independent read-only replay. Do not call this an end-of-simulation state. No generic reservation policy, GUI visual behavior, or cross-engine equivalence is claimed.
